question.en: What is mandatory for both a motorcycle rider and passenger regarding headwear while riding on a public road?

question.xh: Yintoni emiselweyo ngokomthetho kubomabini abakhweli iimoto-zabini nabakhweli malunga nokunxiba entloko xa bekhwele endleleni yoluntu?
question.zu: Yini emisiwe ngokomthetho kubashayeli bezimoto-mbili nabagibeli mayelana nokwembatha ekhanda uma begibela emgwaqweni omphakathi?

question.en: Which control on a motorcycle is operated by the right hand twist-grip?
question.af: Watter beheerder op 'n motorfiets word deur die regterhand-draaigreep bedien?
question.xh: Sikuphi isilawuli kwimoto-zabini esisebenza ngokujikwa kwesandla sokunene?
question.zu: Yiziphi izilawuli emotweni-mbili ezisebenza ngokujikwa kwesandla sokudla?
question.st: Ke taolo efe ho thuthuthu e sebediswang ka ho phethoha ha letsoho le letona?
question.tn: Ke taolo efe mo dithuthuthung e e dirisiwang ka go sokamisa seatla sa moja?

en.B: B) Clutch lever.
en.C: C) Rear foot brake.

af.A: A) Smoorklep / Versneller.

xh.A: A) I-throttle / Isantya.

zu.A: A) I-throttle / Isivinini.

st.A: A) I-throttle / Sepitikara.
st.B: B) Lever ya clutch.
st.C: C) Boreka ba ka morao bo sebediswang ka leoto.

tn.A: A) I-throttle / Sepitikara.
tn.B: B) Lebole ya kelase.
tn.C: C) Boreka jwa kwa morago jo bo dirisiwang ka lonao.

explanation.en: The right handlebar twist-grip operates the throttle to increase or decrease engine speed.
explanation.af: Die regterhandvatsel-draaigreep bedien die smoorklep om enjinspoed te verhoog of te verlaag.
explanation.xh: Ukujikwa kwehandile yesandla sokunene kusebenzisa i-throttle ukwandisa okanye ukwehlisa isantya senjini.
explanation.zu: Ukujikwa kwehandle lesandla sokudla kusebenzisa i-throttle ukwandisa noma ukwehlisa isivinini senjini.
explanation.st: Ho phethoha ha handlebar ya letsoho le letona ho sebedisa throttle ho eketsa kapa ho fokotsa lebelo la enjine.
explanation.tn: Go sokamisa handlebar ka seatla sa moja go dirisa throttle go oketsa kgotsa go fokotsa lobelo lwa enjene.

question.en: What does an octagonal red sign with white lettering 'STOP' require a motorcycle rider to do?
question.af: Wat vereis 'n agthoekige rooi bord met wit skrif 'STOP' van 'n motorfietsbestuurder?
question.xh: Yintoni efunwa luphawu olubomvu olunemiphetho esibhozo nokubhalwe ngombala omhlophe othi 'STOP' kumkhweli wemoto-zabini?
question.zu: Yini efunwa ngophawu olubomvu olunezingosi eziyisishiyagalombili nokubhalwe okumhlophe okuthi 'STOP' kumshayeli wemoto-mbili?
question.st: Ke eng seo sesupo se sefubedu sa mahlakore a robeli sa mongolo o mosweu se reng 'STOP' se se hlokang ho mokgweli wa thuthuthu?
question.tn: Ke eng se se batlwang ke letshwao le lehibidu la ditlhakore tse robedi le mokwalo o mosweu o reng 'STOP' mo mokgweetsing wa thuthuthu?

en.A: A) Bring the motorcycle to a complete standstill before the stop line.
en.B: B) Slow down and proceed if no cars are coming.
en.C: C) Swerve around the stop line.

af.A: A) Bring die motorfiets tot 'n volledige stilstand voor die stopstreep.
af.B: B) Vertraag en ry voort as daar geen voertuie naderkom nie.

xh.A: A) Yenza imoto-zabini ime ngokupheleleyo phambi komgca wokuma.
xh.B: B) Cotha uqhubeke ukuba akukho zithuthi zizayo.

zu.A: A) Yenza imoto-mbili ime ngokuphelele ngaphambi komugqa wokuma.
zu.B: B) Nciphisa isivinini uqhubeke uma kungekho izimoto ezizayo.

st.A: A) Etsa hore thuthuthu e eme ka botlalo pele ho mola wa ho ema.
st.B: B) Fokotsa lebelo o tswele pele haeba ho se dikoloi tse tlang.
st.C: C) Potoloha mola wa ho ema.

tn.A: A) Dira gore thuthuthu e eme ka botlalo pele ga mola wa go ema.
tn.B: B) Fokotsa lobelo o tsweletse fa go se na dikoloi tse di tlang.
tn.C: C) Kgweetsa go dikologa mola wa go ema.

explanation.en: The R1 Stop sign requires a complete halt of the vehicle before the stop line.
explanation.af: Die R1 Stopteken vereis 'n volledige stilstand van die voertuig voor die stopstreep.
explanation.xh: Uphawu lokuma i-R1 lufuna ukuma ngokupheleleyo kwesithuthi phambi komgca wokuma.
explanation.zu: Uphawu lokuma i-R1 ludinga ukuma okuphelele kwemoto ngaphambi komugqa wokuma.
explanation.st: Sesupo sa ho ema R1 se hloka ho ema ka botlalo ha koloi pele ho mola wa ho ema.
explanation.tn: Letshwao la go ema R1 le batla go ema ka botlalo ga koloi pele ga mola wa go ema.

question.st: Na mokgweli wa thuthuthu o tlameha ho boloka lebone la ka pele le tukile nakong ya motshehare tseleng ya setjhaba?

en.B: B) No, only between sunset and sunrise.

af.A: A) Ja, gedempte ligbundel kop lig moet te alle tye aan wees.

xh.B: B) Hayi, phakathi kokutshona kwelanga nokuphuma kwelanga kuphela.

zu.A: A) Yebo, isibani esehlisiwe kufanele sihlale sivutha ngaso sonke isikhathi.
zu.B: B) Cha, phakathi kokushona kwelanga nokuphuma kwelanga kuphela.

st.A: A) E, lebone le theoletsweng le tlameha ho hlala le tukile nako yohle.

st.C: C) Ha ho na le pula feela.

question.en: What does an inverted triangular sign with a red border (Yield Sign R2) require?
question.af: Wat vereis 'n omgekeerde driehoekige bord met 'n rooi grens (Toegee-teken R2)?
question.xh: Yintoni efunwa luphawu olujikelekileyo olunxenxelisiweyo olunomda obomvu (Uphawu Lokuvumela R2)?
question.zu: Yini efunwa uphawu olunxenxelisiwe olunengosi ezintathu olunomngcele obomvu (Uphawu Lokuvumela Ukuhamba R2)?
question.st: Ke eng seo se hlokwang ke sesupo se sekgutshwanyane se fetotsweng se nang le moeli o mofubedu (Sesupo sa ho Fana ka Tsela R2)?
question.tn: Ke eng se se batlwang ke letshwao le le fetotsweng le le nang le moedi o mohibidu (Letshwao la go Fa Tsela R2)?

en.A: A) Give way to all cross traffic and pedestrians.
en.B: B) Accelerate ahead of other traffic.
en.C: C) Stop for exactly 3 seconds always.

af.A: A) Gee pad aan alle kruisverkeer en voetgangers.
af.C: C) Stop altyd vir presies 3 sekondes.

xh.A: A) Nika indlela kuyo yonke ithrafikhi enqumlayo nabahamba ngeenyawo.
xh.C: C) Ma amazinga amathathu ngamandla ngalo lonke ixesha.

zu.A: A) Nika indlela kuwo wonke amaphathwa aphambana nabahamba ngezinyawo.

st.A: A) Fana ka tsela ho sephethephethe kaofela se tshelang le baeti ba maotong.
st.B: B) Akgehla pele ho sephethephethe se seng.
st.C: C) Ema ka metsotswana e meraro nako yohle.

tn.A: A) Fa dipalangwa tsotlhe tse di kgabaganyang le batsamai ba dinao tsela.
tn.B: B) Akofisa fa pele ga dipalangwa tse dingwe.
tn.C: C) Ema metsotswana e le meraro ka nako tsotlhe.

explanation.en: The R2 Yield sign requires giving right-of-way to approaching traffic before entering.
explanation.af: Die R2 Toegee-teken vereis dat voorrang gegee word aan naderende verkeer voordat mens instap.
explanation.xh: Uphawu Lokuvumela i-R2 lufuna ukunikwa kwendlela kwithrafikhi ezayo phambi kokungena.
explanation.zu: Uphawu Lokuvumela Ukuhamba i-R2 ludinga ukunikwa kwendlela kwithrafikhi ezayo ngaphambi kokungena.
explanation.st: Sesupo sa ho Fana ka Tsela R2 se hloka ho fuwa ha tsela ho sephethephethe se tlang pele ho kena.
explanation.tn: Letshwao la go Fa Tsela R2 le batla go fiwa ga tsela mo dipalangweng tse di tlang pele ga go tsena.

en.B: B) Dangling near the road surface.
en.C: C) Resting on the front mudguard.

af.A: A) Stewig rustend op die voetsteunties.
af.C: C) Rustend op die voorste modskerm.

tn.A: A) Di iketleeditse sentle mo diikhutsong tsa dinao.

question.en: Under what condition may a motorcycle carry a pillion passenger?
question.af: Onder watter voorwaarde mag 'n motorfiets 'n agterpassasier vervoer?
question.xh: Phantsi kwayiphi imeko apho imoto-zabini inokuthwala khona umkhweli wangasemva?
question.zu: Ngaphansi kwaziphi izimo lapho imoto-mbili ingathwala khona umgibeli wangemuva?
question.st: Ke tlas'a maemo afe thuthuthu e ka jarang mopalami wa ka morao?
question.tn: Ke tlas'a maemo afe thuthuthu e ka rwalang mopalami wa kwa morago?

en.A: A) If equipped with a suitable pillion seat, footrests, and passenger is over 10 years old with feet reaching footrests.
en.B: B) Any passenger under 50 kg sitting on the fuel tank.
en.C: C) Up to two passengers if sitting behind the rider.

af.A: A) Indien toegerus met 'n geskikte agterpassasiersitplek, voetsteunties, en die passasier ouer as 10 jaar is met voete wat die voetsteunties bereik.
af.B: B) Enige passasier onder 50 kg wat op die brandstoftenk sit.
af.C: C) Tot twee passasiers indien hulle agter die bestuurder sit.

xh.A: A) Ukuba ihlomele ngesihlalo esifanelekileyo somkhweli wangasemva, iindawo zokuphumza iinyawo, kwaye umkhweli uneminyaka engaphezulu kwe-10 ubudala neenyawo ezifikelela kwiindawo zokuphumza iinyawo.
xh.B: B) Nawuphi na umkhweli ongaphantsi kwe-50 kg ohleli kwitanki lepetroli.
xh.C: C) Ukuya kubakhweli ababini ukuba bahleli ngasemva komkhweli.

zu.A: A) Uma ihlomele ngesihlalo esifanele somgibeli wangemuva, izisekelo zezinyawo, futhi umgibeli eneminyaka engaphezu kwe-10 ubudala ngezinyawo ezifinyelela ezisekelweni.
zu.B: B) Noma yimuphi umgibeli ongaphansi kuka-50 kg ohlezi ethangini likaphethiloli.
zu.C: C) Kuya kubagibeli ababili uma behlezi ngemuva komshayeli.

st.A: A) Haeba e hlometse ka setulo se loketseng sa mopalami wa ka morao, diphomo tsa maoto, mme mopalami a le dilemo tse fetang 10 ka maoto a fihlellang diphomo.
st.B: B) Mopalami leha e le ofe ya ka tlase ho 50 kg ya dutseng holim'a tanka ya peterole.
st.C: C) Ho fihla ho bapalami ba babedi haeba ba dutse ka morao ho mokgweli.

tn.A: A) Fa e na le setulo se se tshwanetseng sa mopalami wa kwa morago, diikhutso tsa dinao, mme mopalami a na le dingwaga tse fetang 10 ka dinao tse fitlhelelang diikhutso.
tn.B: B) Mopalami ope fela yo o kwa tlase ga 50 kg yo o ntseng mo tanking ya peterole.
tn.C: C) Go fitlha go bapalami ba le babedi fa ba ntse kwa morago ga mokgweetsi.

explanation.en: Pillion passengers require a proper seat, separate footrests, helmet, and must be able to reach the footrests.
explanation.af: Agterpassasiers benodig 'n behoorlike sitplek, aparte voetsteunties, valhelm, en moet die voetsteunties kan bereik.
explanation.xh: Abakhweli bangasemva bafuna isihlalo esifanelekileyo, iindawo zokuphumza iinyawo ezahlukeneyo, ikhaskiti, kwaye kufuneka bakwazi ukufikelela kwiindawo zokuphumza iinyawo.
explanation.zu: Abagibeli bangemuva badinga isihlalo esifanele, izisekelo zezinyawo ezihlukene, isivikelo sekhanda, futhi kufanele bakwazi ukufinyelela ezisekelweni zezinyawo.
explanation.st: Bapalami ba ka morao ba hloka setulo se nepahetseng, diphomo tsa maoto tse arohaneng, kepe ya tshireletso, mme ba tlameha ho kgona ho fihlella diphomo tsa maoto.
explanation.tn: Bapalami ba kwa morago ba tlhoka setulo se se tshwanetseng, diikhutso tsa dinao tse di farologaneng, kepe, mme ba tshwanetse go kgona go fitlhelela diikhutso tsa dinao.

question.en: What is the legal restriction regarding riding motorcycles abreast (side-by-side) in the same lane?
question.af: Wat is die wettige beperking rakende motorfietse wat langs mekaar (naas mekaar) in dieselfde baan ry?
question.xh: Yintoni umda womthetho malunga nokukhwela iimoto-zabini ecaleni komnye (ecaleni) kumgca ofanayo?
question.zu: Yini imikhawulo yomthetho mayelana nokugibela amamoto-mbili eceleni komunye (eceleni) emgwaqweni ofanayo?
question.st: Ke thibelo efe ya molao mabapi le ho palama dithuthuthu ka mahlakoreng (ka thoko le thoko) mmileng o le mong?
question.tn: Ke thibelo efe ya molao mabapi le go palama dithuthuthu di le fa thoko le thoko mo mmileng o le mongwe?

en.A: A) Maximum of two motorcycles may ride abreast in a single lane, provided the lane width allows it safely.
en.B: B) Unlimited motorcycles may pack into one lane.
en.C: C) Riding abreast is strictly illegal in all circumstances.

af.A: A) Hoogstens twee motorfietse mag langs mekaar in 'n enkele baan ry, mits die baanbreedte dit veilig toelaat.
af.B: B) Onbeperkte motorfietse mag in een baan saamgepak word.
af.C: C) Om langs mekaar te ry is streng onwettig in alle omstandighede.

xh.A: A) Iimoto-zabini ezimbini kuphela zinokukhwela ecaleni komnye kumgca omnye, ukuba ububanzi bomgca buyavumela ngokukhuselekileyo.
xh.B: B) Iimoto-zabini ezingenamda zinokuxinana kumgca omnye.
xh.C: C) Ukukhwela ecaleni komnye akusemthethweni ngokupheleleyo kuzo zonke iimeko.

zu.A: A) Amamoto-mbili amabili kuphela angagibela eceleni komunye emgwaqeni owodwa, uma ububanzi bomgwaqo buvumela lokho ngokuphepha.
zu.B: B) Amamoto-mbili angenamkhawulo angagxilisana emgwaqeni owodwa.
zu.C: C) Ukugibela eceleni komunye kungekho emthethweni ngokuphelele kuzo zonke izimo.

st.A: A) Bonyane dithuthuthu tse pedi di ka palama ka mahlakoreng mmileng o le mong, haeba bophara ba mmila bo dumella ka polokeho.
st.B: B) Dithuthuthu tse sa lekanyetsoang di ka kgobokana mmileng o le mong.
st.C: C) Ho palama ka mahlakoreng ha ho a dumellwa ka molao ho maemo kaofela.

tn.A: A) Bonnyennyennye dithuthuthu tse pedi di ka palama di le fa thoko mo mmileng o le mongwe, fa bophara jwa mmila bo letla seno ka polokego.
tn.B: B) Dithuthuthu tse di se nang selekanyo di ka kitlanngwa mo mmileng o le mongwe.
tn.C: C) Go palama di le fa thoko go ganediwa ka molao ka botlalo mo maemong otlhe.

explanation.en: Not more than two motorcycles may ride side-by-side in a single traffic lane.
explanation.af: Nie meer as twee motorfietse mag langs mekaar in 'n enkele verkeersbaan ry nie.
explanation.xh: Akuvumelekanga iimoto-zabini ezingaphezu kwezimbini ukuba zikhwele ecaleni komnye kumgca omnye wendlela.
explanation.zu: Akuvunyelwe amamoto-mbili angaphezu kwamabili ukuthi agibele eceleni komunye emgwaqeni owodwa wetrafikhi.
explanation.st: Ha ho dumellwa dithuthuthu tse fetang tse pedi ho palama ka thoko le thoko mmileng o le mong wa sephethephethe.
explanation.tn: Ga go letlelelwa dithuthuthu tse di fetang pedi go palama di le fa thoko mo mmileng o le mongwe wa sephethephethe.

memory_tricks.st: Tse pedi feela ka thoko — tse tharo ke ranka ya ditekisi!

question.en: What is the minimum engine displacement allowed for a motorcycle to operate legally on a freeway?
question.af: Wat is die minimum enjinkapasiteit toegelaat vir 'n motorfiets om wettig op 'n snelweg te ry?
question.xh: Nguwuphi umlinganiselo osezantsi wamandla enjini ovumelekileyo kwimoto-zabini ukuze isebenze ngokusemthethweni kwindlela enkulu?
question.zu: Yiliphi izinga eliphansi lomthamo wenjini elivunyelwe kumoto-mbili ukuze isebenze ngokusemthethweni emgwaqeni omkhulu?
question.st: Ke boholo bofe bo tlase ba enjine bo dumelletsweng ho thuthuthu ho sebetsa ka molao tseleng e kgolo?
question.tn: Ke bogolo bofe jo bo kwa tlase jwa enjene jo bo letleletsweng mo thuthuthung go dira ka molao mo tseleng e kgolo?

en.A: A) Exceeding 50 cc (50cm³).
en.B: B) Exceeding 125 cc.
en.C: C) Any engine size if traveling over 60 km/h.

af.A: A) Meer as 50 cc (50cm³).
af.C: C) Enige enjingrootte indien teen meer as 60 km/h gery word.

xh.A: A) Ngaphezulu kwe-50 cc (50cm³).
xh.C: C) Nawuphi na umlinganiselo wenjini ukuba kuhanjwa ngaphezulu kwe-60 km/h.

zu.A: A) Ngaphezu kuka-50 cc (50cm³).
zu.C: C) Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senjini uma kuhanjwa ngaphezu kuka-60 km/h.

st.A: A) Ho feta 50 cc (50cm³).
st.B: B) Ho feta 125 cc.
st.C: C) Boholo bofe kapa bofe ba enjine haeba ho tsamaiwa ka ho feta 60 km/h.

tn.A: A) Go feta 50 cc (50cm³).
tn.B: B) Go feta 125 cc.
tn.C: C) Bogolo bope fela jwa enjene fa go tsamaiwa ka go feta 60 km/h.

explanation.en: Motorcycles with an engine capacity of 50cc or less are prohibited from freeways.
explanation.af: Motorfietse met 'n enjinkapasiteit van 50cc of minder word van snelweë verbied.

explanation.en: Gear selection on a motorcycle is controlled using the left foot lever (1 down, 4/5 up).

question.en: What is the maximum width of cargo or luggage permitted to project on either side of a motorcycle?
question.af: Wat is die maksimum breedte van vrag of bagasie wat toegelaat word om aan weerskante van 'n motorfiets uit te steek?
question.xh: Yintoni ububanzi obukhulu bomthwalo okanye impahla evunyelweyo ukuba iphume macala omabini emoto-zabini?
question.zu: Yibuphi ububanzi obukhulu bomthwalo noma impahla evunyelwe ukuphuma nhlangothi zombili zemoto-mbili?
question.st: Ke bophara bofe bo boholo ba thepa kapa mekotla e dumelletsweng ho tholeha mahlakoreng ka bobedi a thuthuthu?
question.tn: Ke bophara bofe jo bogolo jwa morwalo kgotsa dithoto tse di letleletsweng go tswela kwa ntle ka fa letlhakoreng lengwe le lengwe la thuthuthu?

en.A: A) 450 mm on either side of the longitudinal centerline.
en.B: B) 600 mm on either side.
en.C: C) 900 mm total width.

af.A: A) 450 mm aan weerskante van die lengte-middellyn.

xh.A: A) 450 mm macala omabini omgca ophakathi ende.

zu.A: A) 450 mm nhlangothi zombili zomugqa ophakathi obude.

st.A: A) 450 mm mahlakoreng ka bobedi a mola o bolelele wa hara.
st.B: B) 600 mm mahlakoreng ka bobedi.
st.C: C) 900 mm bophara bo felletseng.

tn.A: A) 450 mm ka fa letlhakoreng lengwe le lengwe la mola o o boleele wa mo gare.
tn.B: B) 600 mm ka fa letlhakoreng lengwe le lengwe.
tn.C: C) 900 mm bophara jotlhe.

explanation.en: Cargo carried on a motorcycle must not extend beyond 450 mm on either side of the bike's centerline.
explanation.af: Vrag wat op 'n motorfiets vervoer word, mag nie verder as 450 mm aan weerskante van die fiets se middellyn uitsteek nie.
explanation.xh: Umthwalo othwalwa kwimoto-zabini akufuneki uphume ngaphezulu kwe-450 mm macala omabini omgca ophakathi wemoto-zabini.
explanation.zu: Umthwalo othwalwa emotweni-mbili awuvumelekile ukuphuma ngaphezu kuka-450 mm nhlangothi zombili zomugqa ophakathi wemoto-mbili.
explanation.st: Thepa e jarwang thuthuthung ha e a lokela ho tholeha ho feta 450 mm mahlakoreng ka bobedi a mola o hara wa thuthuthu.
explanation.tn: Morwalo o o rwelwang mo thuthuthung ga o a tshwanela go feta 450 mm ka fa letlhakoreng lengwe le lengwe la mola wa mo gare wa thuthuthu.

question.en: How is the clutch lever operated on a manual transmission motorcycle?
question.af: Hoe word die koppelaarhefboom bedien op 'n motorfiets met handrat-oordrag?
question.xh: Ihandile yeklashi isebenza njani kwimoto-zabini enegiya elenziwa ngesandla?
question.zu: Ihandle yekhulushi isebenza kanjani emotweni-mbili enegiya elenziwa ngesandla?
question.st: Lever ya clutch e sebetsa jwang thuthuthung e nang le phetoho ya magiya e etswang ka letsoho?
question.tn: Lebole la kelase le dira jang mo thuthuthung e e nang le go fetola magia ka seatla?

en.A: A) Squeezed with the left hand fingers on the left handlebar.
en.B: B) Pressed with the left foot pedal.
en.C: C) Twisted with the right wrist.

af.A: A) Gedruk met die linkerhandvingers op die linkerstuur.

xh.A: A) Icinezelwa ngeminwe yesandla sasekhohlo kwihandlebar yasekhohlo.

zu.A: A) Icindezelwa ngeminwe yesandla sobunxele ehandlebar yesobunxele.

st.A: A) E hatelwa ka menwana ya letsoho le letshehadi ho handlebar e letshehadi.
st.B: B) E hatelwa ka pedale ya leoto le letshehadi.
st.C: C) E phethohiswa ka sekhono se letona.

tn.A: A) Le gatelelwa ka menwana ya seatla sa molema mo handlebar ya molema.
tn.B: B) Le gatelelwa ka petale ya lonao lwa molema.
tn.C: C) Le sokamisiwa ka lebogo la moja.

explanation.en: The clutch lever is located on the left handlebar and is operated by the left hand fingers.
explanation.af: Die koppelaarhefboom is geleë op die linkerstuur en word bedien deur die linkerhandvingers.
explanation.xh: Ihandile yeklashi ifumaneka kwihandlebar yasekhohlo yaye isetyenziswa ngeminwe yesandla sasekhohlo.
explanation.zu: Ihandle yekhulushi itholakala ehandlebar yesobunxele futhi isetshenziswa ngeminwe yesandla sobunxele.
explanation.st: Lever ya clutch e fumaneha ho handlebar e letshehadi mme e sebediswa ka menwana ya letsoho le letshehadi.
explanation.tn: Lebole la kelase le fitlhelwa mo handlebar ya molema mme le dirisiwa ka menwana ya seatla sa molema.
